Use this file in combination with the complete USWDS components to prototype and mock-up designs for your website. You can find all assets and all associated fonts and images at  https://designsystem.digital.gov/documentation/designers/. 

Note: You’re free to use, modify, and repurpose this document to fit your particular project needs. This resource accompanies the broader guidelines in the USDA Digital Strategy at https://usda.gov/digitalstrategy. If you have comments on this tool or the Digital Strategy, please send your feedback to feedback@usda.gov.
